en: Fixed background commands, the agents view and daemon workers sending telemetry and a feature-flag request to Anthropic behind a Claude apps gateway when no managed settings on the machine force gateway login
zh: 修复了当机器上没有任何托管设置强制网关登录时，后台命令、agents 视图和守护进程 worker 在 Claude 应用网关之后仍向 Anthropic 发送遥测和功能标志请求的问题
